ITEM 1 | Scrambled eggs-like mass of soft, pale yellow curds with orange-tinged flecks scattered through, moist-looking, loosely clumped, crumbly edges, sitting in the upper-left portion of the plate; roughly 9 cm across and 2 cm high at its thickest | 110
ITEM 2 | Cubed roasted pieces, orange-brown with darker caramelized edges and a slightly glossy, sticky-looking surface, irregular cut chunks about 2 to 3 cm per side, clustered in the lower-left of the plate; they hold their shape, firm and dense | 150
ITEM 3 | Thick-cut bacon strips, reddish-brown with glossy, rendered fat sheen and crisp-looking browned edges, several overlapping strips curving across the right side of the plate, each about 1 cm thick and 10 to 12 cm long | 90
ITEM 4 | Small pieces of darker, browned, glossy meat-like strip (bacon ends) tucked between the cubes and the bacon, about 1 cm wide, partially hidden under the other items | 15
